author: Света Изуграфова
text:
When I go to the cafe - I expect that waitress will smile, say good morning and wish all the best; everyone wants fast and quality service, and tasty food. Here you can get a tasty food, but the service is completely terrible. Don't recommend this place.

15.11.25 -  PanPan Atelier met me with a huge queue, which is uncomfortable, but a plus because it shows that people recommend this place. Despite the amount of people - tables are small, good for 1-3 people only.
Their staff is very tired and nervous, every client feels that they just want to get your order and move to the next person. No smiles, no good words, and total tiredness on the faces. In my case I ordered cappuccino with eclair, and asked for sugar for coffee. Staff forgot to give me sugar and I had to come back and ask again.

When I started eating, I noticed that my fork wasn't clean, I saw fingerprints and some food from another dish on it, and it's pretty disgusting for me.

The price is normal - 5€ for eclair and cappuccino, and the food is tasty, unfortunately these are the only advantages. Don't recommend this place.

response:
Response from the owner 9 months ago
We are very sorry you had a bad experience with us. Sometimes, as people, we all have good days and bad days, but that's no excuse for not saying good morning and a smile. We will speak with the team to improve customer service and see what we can do as a company to address these situations. Apologies from the entire Panpan Atelier team.

author: misael riojas
text:

author: Mohammad Ebrahim
text:
A beautiful spot for breakfast, brunch, and coffee.

I had a great Cafe con Leche, and some delicious pastries.

You can find delicious baked goods and more.

Everything is freshly baked and prepared.

Highly recommended.
